## Attribution

- Every logged term matches: model 6837.87 MiB, KV + indexer KV, RS
  145.56 MiB, cache slabs within 16 KiB of (K + 1) × slab.
- Outside all logged terms: 414–564 MiB per point (ggml legacy HIP pool
  320–359 MB peak with VMM off, plus runtime workspaces) →
  `ROCM_SESSION_OVERHEAD` = 544 MiB.
- First session leaves 233–256 MB resident, constant across 5 reloads
  (one-time HIP init); the test warms up before `free0`.
- Over-prediction peaks at ctx 32768 / ubatch ≥ 2048: llama's buffer there is
  909 KB per ubatch token vs the 1.106 MB fitted at ctx 65536.
- Compute buffers are quant-independent: UD-IQ3_XXS logged UD-Q4_K_XL's bytes
  at 131072/512 and 65536/2048.

## 2026-10-29 re-run (#83): fail, ws refit

GLM-5.3-Flash UD-IQ3_XXS, KV q8_0, flash attention on, 26 points
(`GOLEM_T8_MAX_POINTS=60`, ctx 2048–131072 × ubatch 512–4096), commit
9e4716e, `scripts/hw-m54.sh t7`. 0 SKIPPED. **Fail**: over-prediction
1 621 409 016 B at ctx 4096 / ubatch 4096 (gate 1 GiB); under-prediction 0.

Cause: the compute buffer shrank since the 2026-10-18 run (q8_0 KV and the
vendor changes since): 688 MiB at 2048/1024 vs 685, but 845 MiB at
65536/1024 vs 1080 and 589 MiB at 131072/512 vs 957. It is ubatch-linear at
every ctx, with a per-ubatch-token slope that grows with ctx: 704 KB at
ctx 2048, 720 KB at 8192, 781 KB at 32768, 864 KB at 65536, 1.20 MB at
131072. The old fit (flat 1.106 MB/token above ctx 2052, plus 320 MiB +
5 138 B/ctx token) over-predicts every small-ctx, large-ubatch point.

Refit `WS_MEASURED` = `max(320 MiB, ubatch · max(699 500 + 3·ctx, 9·ctx))`:
every compute point within −40 / +127 MiB. "refit delta" is the recorded
delta with the old ws term swapped for the refit (−72 / +189 MiB), not a
re-measurement; the T8 gate passes only once `hw-m54.sh t7` re-runs green.
